notes.title: Update v.1.01
Release of the game!
notes.notes:
Yesterday (March 19), the "Chronicle of Daneya" was finally released. Not without nuances, but everything is ok now, so I look forward to feedback, comments and suggestions for the game. 
Do not hesitate to write about everything you are interested in.

With best wishes, Robot D :)
